evals.expected_output: Scores a new rep's early call against every dimension in references/rubric.md (strong opening, open-ended questioning, pain & priority uncovered, trigger surfaced, pitch clarity, rapport). Every dimension gets a Status (Covered/Partial/Missed/Unclear) and, for anything not fully covered, a one-line Note. Every finding is backed by a direct quote or timestamp from the transcript — no unsourced findings. Closes with the highest-leverage next step(s), not a restated summary of every gap.
expectations: Every dimension in the rubric gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
No finding is asserted without evidence
Closes with a small number of concrete next-step(s), not a full recap
Cites at least one specific, concrete detail from the transcript (a number, name, or quoted phrase) rather than a generic paraphrase that could apply to any call
evals.name: first-call-rampup-eval-1

evals.prompt: run first-call-rampup on a transcript of a call that, by any reasonable read, covered a new rep's early call's dimensions thoroughly and left little unaddressed
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed/Partial just because the rubric has many dimensions. The rubric.md 'reads-well-too' check is applied before finalizing: if a clearly strong call still reads as mostly gaps, the evidence bar is loosened rather than reported as-is.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too check from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
evals.name: first-call-rampup-eval-2

evals.expected_output: Declines the CSV file plainly: this skill is transcript-only because it audits rep technique on a specific call, not pipeline-wide data. Does not attempt a partial or best-effort CSV read.
expectations: Declines a .csv input rather than attempting a partial read
States plainly that this skill is transcript-only and why
evals.name: first-call-rampup-eval-3
